project.title: mouse retinal pigmented epithelium (RPE)-LC/MS/MS
project.projectDescription: In this experiment, we compared the phosphorylated protein profile of Cryba1 cKO (RPE-specific) RPE tissue and that of the age-matched control samples.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Protein from RPE-choroid complex tissue were isolated in lysis buffer and digested in trypsin. The peptides were then subjected to Isobaric labeling using TMT-10plex kit. Fractionation of labeled peptides was performed by basic reverse phase HPLC. The LC/MS/MS analysis of samples were carried out using a Thermo Scientific Q-Exactive hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap Mass Spectrometer and a Thermo Dionex UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano System.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: MS raw files analysis using Thermofisher Scientific Proteome Discoverer 1.4 for database search.
